# Heureka – The Finnish Science Centre

> > Finland's premier science center offering interactive exhibitions, planetarium shows, educational programs, and event facilities in Vantaa.

Heureka (Tiedekeskus Heureka) features permanent and touring exhibitions including 'Our Journey in Space', 'Artificial Intelligence – Me, Myself & AI', and 'Giants of the Ice Age', alongside NOAA's Science on a Sphere, outdoor Science Park Galilei, and educational partnerships with organizations like ESERO Finland, Microsoft, and Biocodex.

## Key Topics

- Interactive science exhibitions
- Planetarium shows
- ESERO Finland space education
- Science on a Sphere (NOAA)
- Our Journey in Space exhibition
- Corporate events & conferences
- Auditorium Virtanen
- Science Theater demonstrations
- Educational workshops for schools
- Heureka Classics permanent exhibits
- Giants of the Ice Age
- Artificial Intelligence exhibitions
- Science Park Galilei outdoor activities
- Touring exhibition rentals
- Climate change education programs

## Visitor Information & Core Experiences

- [Welcome to Heureka](https://www.heureka.fi/en/pages/welcome): Finnish Science Centre homepage: tickets, hours, exhibitions & planetarium
- [Our Journey in Space Exhibition](https://www.heureka.fi/blogs/nayttelyt/matkalla-avaruudessa): Interactive space exhibition with moon walk experience
- [Play and Explore](https://www.heureka.fi/en/blogs/exhibitions/play-and-explore): Power of Play exhibition & Idea Workshop for hands-on learning
- [Outdoor Exhibitions](https://www.heureka.fi/en/blogs/exhibitions/exhibitions-outdoors): Science Park Galilei outdoor exhibitions and summer activities
- [Science on a Sphere](https://www.heureka.fi/en/blogs/exhibitions/science-on-a-sphere): NOAA's spherical display showing satellite climate & space data
- [Joy of Air Science Show](https://www.heureka.fi/en/pages/joy-of-air): Science Theater show featuring air gas demonstrations for families

## Corporate Events & Conference Facilities

- [Events at Heureka](https://www.heureka.fi/en/pages/event-at-heureka): Corporate events & meetings at Heureka Science Center with exhibitions
- [Meeting Facilities (Swedish)](https://www.heureka.fi/sv/pages/moteslokaler): Meeting facilities at Heureka including Auditorium Virtanen
- [Meeting Packages (Swedish)](https://www.heureka.fi/sv/pages/motespaket): Meeting packages & conference pricing at Heureka

## Educational Programs & Materials

- [ESERO Finland Materials](https://www.heureka.fi/en/blogs/oppimateriaalit/esero-finland-materials): ESERO Finland space education materials for schools & classrooms
- [Water Education Materials](https://www.heureka.fi/blogs/oppimateriaalit/vesi-elaman-virta): Water education materials for secondary schools on global water issues
- [Climate Myths Programme](https://www.heureka.fi/en/pages/climate-myths-programme): Climate change education program using NOAA's Science on a Sphere
- [Talking Head Workshop](https://www.heureka.fi/pages/puhuva-paa): Robotics, programming & recycling workshop for schools

## Professional Services & Partnerships

- [Heureka Overseas Productions](https://www.heureka.fi/pages/heureka-overseas-productions): Touring exhibition rental service for international science centers
- [Microsoft Partnership](https://www.heureka.fi/en/pages/kumppanuustarina-heureka-x-microsoft): Microsoft partnership: Robotics Weeks for 5th graders in Espoo region
- [Biocodex Partnership (Swedish)](https://www.heureka.fi/sv/pages/partnerskapshistoria-biocodex): Partnership story: Biocodex gut health exhibition collaboration

## News & Updates

- [Autumn 2025 Program Guide](https://www.heureka.fi/blogs/arkisto/heurekan-syksy): Autumn 2025 program guide: exhibitions, events & family activities
